select * from ( SELECT a.rep_id repId, a.rep_no repNo, a.user_id userId, a.age, a.ecg_start_time ecgStartTime, a.ecg_end_time ecgEndTime, a.company_id companyId, a.report_date reportDate, a.generate_time generateTime, a.report_status reportStatus, a.pdf_time pdfTime, a.rep_type repType, a.confirm_status confirmStatus, ifnull( a.pdf_file_path,'') pdfDownloadAddr, a.user_name userName, a.user_gender userGender, b.user_tel userTel, a.lock_user_id lockUserId, d.company_name companyName, d.company_type companyType, d.rep_template repTemplate, a.doctor_user_id doctorUserId, ifnull(du.user_name, '') doctorUserName, ifnull(u.user_name, '') lockUserName, a.create_user_id createUserId, '' reportStatusName, ifnull(a.reana_status, 0) reanaStatus, ifnull(a.valid_duration, 0) validDuration, ifnull(a.ecg_duration, 0) duration, ( CASE WHEN pdf_time IS NOT NULL AND ifnull(last_rep_changed_time, 0) > ifnull(pdf_time, 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ) updPdf, ( CASE WHEN pdf_time IS NOT NULL THEN '医师报告' ELSE ( CASE WHEN ifnull(da.deep_ana_id, 0) <> 0 THEN ( CASE WHEN ifnull(da.deal_status, 0) = 2 THEN '深度分析完成' ELSE '深度分析处理中' END ) ELSE ( CASE WHEN ifnull(a.lock_user_id, 0) <> 0 THEN '医师分析中' ELSE ( CASE WHEN ifnull(rep_type, 1) = 1 THEN '智能分析完成' ELSE '待医师分析' END ) END ) END ) END ) repStatus, a.dept_name deptName, a.hospital_number hospitalNumber, a.section_number sectionNumber, a.user_reg_flag userRegFlag, a.his_bill_no hisBillNo, ifnull(a.frag_style, 0) fragStyle, a.dept_id deptId, cd.dept_name machDeptName, ifnull(da.deep_ana_id, 0) deepAnaId, ifnull(da.deal_status, 0) dealStatus, ifnull(ifnull( rs.doctor_conclusion, a.doctor_conclusion ),"") doctorConclusion FROM cust_user_ecg_report a INNER JOIN cust_userinfo b ON a.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN comm_system_user u ON a.lock_user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN comm_system_user du ON a.doctor_user_id = du.user_id INNER JOIN comm_company d ON a.company_id = d.company_id INNER JOIN comm_dept cd ON a.dept_id = cd.dept_id LEFT JOIN cust_user_ecg_report_deep_ana da ON da.rep_id = a.rep_id AND da.src = 2 LEFT JOIN cust_user_ecg_report_statistics rs ON a.rep_id = rs.rep_id where a.dept_id in (select distinct dept_id from comm_user_mng_dept where user_id=#{loginUserId}) )temp where 1=1
and repType = 2
and repType <> 3
and repId in (SELECT rep_id FROM cust_user_ecg_report_favorite WHERE user_id = #{loginUserId})
and doctorUserId=#{loginUserId}
and pdfTime is null and ifnull( lockUserId, 0 ) =0 AND NOT EXISTS(select ref_id from cust_user_ecg_report_merge_ref_rep mrr inner JOIN cust_user_ecg_report mr on mrr.merge_rep_id=mr.rep_id and ifnull(mr.pdf_time,'')<>'' where mrr.daily_rep_id=repId)
and pdfDownloadAddr <> ''
and pdfDownloadAddr = ''
and exists (SELECT 1 from cust_user_ecg_report_tag WHERE rep_id= repId AND event_type_id IN(#{tm}))
and userId in (SELECT user_id FROM cust_userinfo WHERE user_tel like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and companyId in (SELECT company_id FROM comm_company WHERE company_name like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and doctorConclusion like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') or repId in (select rep_id from cust_user_ecg_report_statistics where ifnull( doctor_conclusion, '' ) like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')))
and deptId in (SELECT dept_id FROM comm_dept WHERE dept_name like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%'))
and DATE_FORMAT(reportDate,'%Y-%m-%d') >= #{tm}
and DATE_FORMAT(reportDate,'%Y-%m-%d') <= #{tm}
and ${key} like CONCAT('%',#{tm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
order by ${column} ${order}
order by reportDate DESC,reportStatus desc

SELECT rep_id repId, rep_no repNo, ecg_start_time ecg_StartTime, ecg_end_time ecgEndTime, ( CASE WHEN pdf_time IS NOT NULL THEN '医师报告' ELSE '未生成' END ) repStatus FROM cust_user_ecg_report WHERE rep_type = #{repType} AND user_id = #{userId} AND user_name = #{userName} ORDER BY ecg_end_time DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT r.rep_id repId, r.rep_no repNo, r.user_id userId, r.age, r.user_gender userGender, u.weight, ifnull(s.doctor_conclusion, '') doctorConclusion, d.in_desc inDesc, d.out_desc outDesc, d.id FROM cust_user_ecg_report r LEFT JOIN cust_userinfo u ON u.user_id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN cust_user_ecg_report_statistics s ON s.rep_id = r.rep_id LEFT JOIN cust_user_ecg_report_diagnosis d ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.rep_id =#{repId}

select DATE_FORMAT(report_date,'%Y-%m-%d') reportDate from cust_user_ecg_report where rep_type=1 and user_id=#{userId} and user_name=#{userName} and ( DATE_FORMAT(report_date,'%Y-%m')= #{startMonth} or DATE_FORMAT(report_date,'%Y-%m')= #{endMonth})
and dept_id in (select distinct dept_id from comm_user_mng_dept where user_id=#{loginUserId})
